capabilities: Export notes to .docx with one click via command, ribbon, or file menu
Embed wiki-link, local, and remote HTTPS images into the document
Render tables with autofit widths, zebra striping, and per-column alignment
Convert footnotes and task list checkboxes to native Word equivalents
Batch-export folders and pack wikilinked notes with attachments into a zip
extras: Makes one network request type only: downloading remote images during export; states there is no telemetry. Bilingual English/Chinese README. A beta channel is available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into a fully rendered Word document, forcing manual copy-paste or formatting cleanup when sharing with Word users.
summary: One-click exporter that renders Obsidian notes to Word .docx with tables, images, syntax-highlighted code, footnotes, and wikilink zip bundles.
